rule.layer_budget: one batch-averaged vector from previous-step global raw-score Top-B
rule.initialization: uniform 75% budgets for the first step
rule.current_execution: current on-policy token scores with precomputed layer budgets
rule.rounding: largest remainder with exact integer active-row total per sequence

random_control: random current token assignment replaying the exact low_max_abs per-layer budget sequence for training and evaluation
primary_endpoint: final sparse held-out loss versus uniform low_max_abs and dense-fewer at measured total cost
secondary_endpoints: layer-budget trajectory, realized activity, auxiliary operations, dense evaluation, and wall clock

decision_rules.kill: if lagged global loses to uniform low_max_abs, stop with no normalization, EMA, or threshold follow-up
decision_rules.improved_but_not_level_3: if it beats uniform but not dense-fewer, report improved allocation only and do not run body 7
decision_rules.development_level_3: lagged global must beat dense-fewer at final and exact interpolated cost and beat random replay
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

scope_caution: lagged global budgets are executable in real transformers, but raw cross-layer max-activation comparability is untested outside this tagged-arithmetic setting
